source_excerpt:
In the news release, DigitalXForce Scores Triple Win: IDC MarketScape Leader Recognition, Institutional Investment from Arsenal Equity Group and 514% Growth, issued 21-Oct-2026 by DigitalXForce Corporation over PR Newswire, we are advised by the company that changes have been made. The complete, corrected release follows, with additional details at the end:
DigitalXForce Scores Triple Win: IDC MarketScape Leader Recognition, Institutional Investment from Arsenal Growth Equity and 514% Growth
AI-native Enterprise TRiSCM™ innovator secures institutional backing, earns Leader recognition in GRC and Third-Party Risk Management, and accelerates global expansion
DALLAS , Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- DigitalXForce today announced the launch of the industry's first Enterprise TRiSCM™ (Trust, Risk, and Security Management) platform designed for the AI and Quantum era, introducing a new operating model for organizations to manage Trust, Risk, Security and Compliance through continuous assurance, operational intelligence and autonomous risk operation.
DigitalXForce , the AI-native Enterprise Trust, Risk, Security and Compliance Management (TRiSCM™) platform, today announced a strategic institutional investment from Arsenal Growth Equity to accelerate global expansion, enterprise adoption and AI-powered innovation.
DigitalXForce , the AI-native Enterprise Trust, Risk, Security and Compliance Management (TRiSCM™) platform, today announced a strategic institutional investment from Arsenal Growth Equity to accelerate global expansion, enterprise adoption and AI-powered innovation.
The investment follows a period of exceptional momentum for DigitalXForce, highlighted by three major milestones:
IDC MarketScape Leader Recognition: DigitalXForce was named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Third-Party Risk Management Software 2026 Vendor Assessment (Doc #US53007725, September 2026), following its Leader positioning in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Governance, Risk, and Compliance Software Vendor Assessment, 2025 (Doc #US53615325, June 2025).
514% Growth: DigitalXForce was recognized as the second fastest-growing technology company in North Texas in the 2026 Tech Titans Fast Tech Awards.
Strategic Institutional Investment: Arsenal Growth Equity 's investment will support the company's next phase of global growth, product innovation and enterprise market expansion.
Together, these milestones reinforce DigitalXForce's evolution from an emerging GRC innovator into a rapidly scaling enterprise technology company advancing the shift toward continuous Digital Trust and AI-powered Risk Intelligence .
Institutional Investment to Accelerate Global Scale
The strategic investment from Arsenal Growth Equity will support DigitalXForce's expansion across North America, the Middle East, Europe and Asia-Pacific, while strengthening its global enterprise sales, partner ecosystem and product engineering capabilities.
The company plans to accelerate investment in its unified Enterprise TRiSCM™ platform, including Automated GRC, Continuous Control Assurance, Third-Party Risk Management, AI Risk Governance, Enterprise Security Posture Management and X-ROC™ Risk Operations.
The funding also supports DigitalXForce's strategy to deepen relationships with global systems integrators, consulting organizations, technology partners and regional distributors.
"Our 514% growth, IDC MarketScape Leader recognition and Arsenal Growth Equity 's investment validate our vision. We are scaling AI-powered Enterprise TRiSCM and XForce Risk Operations Center (X-ROC) globally to redefine Digital Trust."
— Lalit Ahluwalia, Founder & CEO, DigitalXForce
"DigitalXForce brings together exceptional growth, differentiated AI-native technology and a compelling vision for enterprise risk management. Its industry recognition and global market momentum reinforce our conviction in the company's ability to scale and establish a leadership position in Digital Trust. We are excited to partner with Lalit and the DigitalXForce team as they enter their next phase of growth."
— Jason Rottenberg, General Partner, Arsenal Growth Equity
Recognized as a Leader in Two IDC MarketScape Assessments
DigitalXForce's latest recognition in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Third-Party Risk Management Software 2026 Vendor Assessment marks another significant milestone in its Enterprise TRiSCM strategy.
The assessment evaluated third-party risk management software providers based on their capabilities and strategies, positioning DigitalXForce in the Leaders category.
The recognition follows DigitalXForce's Leader positioning in the 2025 IDC MarketScape for Governance, Risk and Compliance software.
Together, the two assessments recognize DigitalXForce's competitive positioning across complementary enterprise risk management markets.
DigitalXForce's architecture brings third-party risk management, automated GRC and continuous control monitoring together on a unified platform, enabling enterprises to manage internal and external risk through connected evidence, common controls and continuously updated risk intelligence.
Transforming Third-Party Risk from Questionnaires to Continuous Intelligence
Traditional third-party risk management programs often rely on annual questionnaires, manual evidence reviews and periodic vendor assessments.
However, expanding supplier ecosystems, cybersecurity threats and regulations such as DORA and NIS2 are increasing the need for ongoing oversight.
DigitalXForce's Automated Third-Party Risk Management with External Risk View combines:
Risk-based vendor classification and tiering.
AI-assisted questionnaire and document analysis.
Continuous external attack surface and cyber risk intelligence.
Vulnerability, misconfiguration and breach exposure monitoring.
Automated risk scoring, remediation workflows and SLA tracking.
Unified evidence mapping across regulatory and compliance frameworks.
Unlike standalone third-party assessment tools, DigitalXForce integrates supplier risk intelligence with an organization's internal security, compliance and enterprise risk posture.
This enables risk teams to move beyond periodic vendor attestations toward continuous, evidence-driven third-party risk management .
From Traditional GRC to Enterprise Digital Trust
DigitalXForce is building a unified operating model for enterprise trust, risk, security and compliance.
Its Enterprise TRiSCM™ platform brings together 15 integrated modules on a common data layer, with controls mapped across more than 50 compliance frameworks and supported by more than 250 technology integrations.
Two proprietary AI engines, AI JedAI and XForce GPT , support capabilities spanning evidence analysis, control testing, risk quantification, policy intelligence and remediation orchestration.
The platform is designed to help enterprises transition:
From Periodic GRC → Continuous Control Assurance
From Fragmented Risk Tools → Unified Enterprise TRiSCM™
From Vendor Questionnaires → Continuous Third-Party Risk Intelligence
From Reactive Risk Management → Proactive Risk Operations
From Compliance Reporting → Measurable Digital Trust
DigitalXForce is extending this vision through X-ROC™, its Risk Operations Center approach, designed to help organizations continuously monitor, prioritize and manage enterprise risk.
DigitalXForce's 514% three-year growth and No. 2 ranking in the 2026 Tech Titans Fast Tech Awards reflect increasing market demand for automated, AI-native approaches to risk, cybersecurity and compliance.
Founded in North Texas in 2023, DigitalXForce has expanded into international markets, supporting organizations navigating complex enterprise risk, regulatory requirements and digital transformation initiatives.
Its hybrid deployment architecture also enables organizations to address regional data residency and sovereignty requirements while benefiting from centralized governance and AI-powered risk intelligence.
With institutional backing, two IDC MarketScape Leader recognitions and continued international expansion, DigitalXForce is positioned to pursue its next stage of enterprise growth.
As organizations adopt AI, cloud technologies and increasingly interconnected digital ecosystems, traditional point-in-time risk assessments are becoming insufficient.
DigitalXForce believes the future belongs to platforms that continuously connect security, governance, compliance, third-party exposure, resilience and enterprise risk into a unified view of organizational trust.
From GRC to Enterprise TRiSCM™. From periodic compliance to continuous assurance. From managing risk to building Digital Trust.
With the support of Arsenal Growth Equity , DigitalXForce intends to accelerate that transformation globally.
About DigitalXForce — We Stop Risk Before It Strikes.
DigitalXForce, Industry's first AI-Powered Enterprise TRiSCM (Trust, Risk, Security and Compliance Management) Platform , is pioneering the next generation of Automated GRC with Continuous Trust Assurance by converging AI, cybersecurity, compliance, operational resilience, and posture management into one unified Risk Intelligence platform. Designed with a modular and composable architecture, DigitalXForce delivers an integrated suite of capabilities spanning automated GRC , Enterprise Security Risk Posture Management (ESRPM) , Third-Party Risk Management , Cyber Resilience , and Regulatory Compliance .
At the core of DigitalXForce is its AI-powered engine , which leverages intelligent agents, machine learning models, and a dynamic control library to autonomously monitor controls, map evidence, assess risks, and generate real-time insights. Trusted by global enterprises across healthcare, finance, critical infrastructure, and technology sectors, DigitalXForce delivers measurable value by reducing manual effort, accelerating audit readiness, and improving organizational resilience in today's fast-evolving threat and compliance landscape.
Learn more about DigitalXForce at https://digitalxforce.com
IDC MarketScape vendor assessment model is designed to provide an overview of the competitive fitness of technology and service suppliers in a given market. The research utilizes a rigorous scoring methodology based on both qualitative and quantitative criteria that results in a single graphical illustration of each supplier's position within a given market. IDC MarketScape provides a clear framework in which the product and service offerings, capabilities and strategies, and current and future market success factors of technology suppliers can be meaningfully compared. The framework also provides technology buyers with a 360-degree assessment of the strengths and weaknesses of current and prospective suppliers.
